free_tier.stated: Free plan: access to all free models at no token charge, 200 requests per day and 20 requests per minute for a new organization, counted across all free models combined; free models include nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, google/gemma-4-31b-it and poolside/laguna-m.1
free_tier.notes: the docs mark the models 'free for now' and announce any price change in the changelog ahead of time; paying organizations get 1,000 requests per day and 60 per minute

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://router.requesty.ai/v1 with the model id written provider/model; an Anthropic-style /anthropic/v1/messages path also exists
chaining: the free models route through the same gateway as the 600+ paid ones, so a fallback policy can move to a paid model when the daily limit is hit

limits.value: new organizations: 200 requests per day and 20 requests per minute across all free models combined; paying organizations: 1,000 per day and 60 per minute; daily limit resets daily

identity_cost.detail: no credit card required for the free models, quoted from the pricing and FAQ pages; the sign-up form at app.requesty.ai was not captured, so any further check on it is not established

reliability_note: free models are labelled free for now and the limit is shared across all of them, so one busy model exhausts the budget for the others
confidence_note: limits and the no-card statement are quoted from the vendor's docs and pricing pages; no call was made.

evidence.proved: the Free plan needs no credit card
the Free plan allows 200 requests per day
new organizations get 200 requests per day and 20 per minute on free models
paying organizations get 1,000 requests per day and 60 per minute on free models
the limit is shared across every free model rather than per model
evidence.quote: The limits apply across all free models combined.

evidence.proved: the free status is explicitly provisional

binding_note: the 200 requests per day budget is shared across all free models and binds long before any per-minute figure
notes: per-model limits do not exist: the figures are per organization across all free models.
